intro: My work blends written and visual storytelling to document human rights, environmental issues and community-led movements. Through interviews, profiles, photography and digital narratives, I aim to tell stories that shift understanding and build empathy.

items.title: Spotlighting Community-Based Research
items.description: Wrote and interviewed three articles on community-based research practitioners across the Mekong region.

items.title: Shelter City Human Rights Update
items.description: A human rights update on Instagram Stories, letting Shelter City guests raise awareness of their work while staying anonymous. Updates covered arbitrary detention of HRDs in Venezuela, new anti-LGBT legislation in Iraq, the foreign agent law in Kyrgyzstan, and rising violence against Indigenous and environmental rights defenders in the Philippines.

items.title: Shelter City Resource Campaign
items.description: Working on Shelter City branding at Justice & Peace NL, I revamped and revised the resource campaign designed to inform and support human rights defenders and former guests around the world. Posts went out every two weeks with clear, vivid updates on useful resources in the sector.

items.title: Human Rights Defender Stories
items.description: In-depth stories on human rights defenders, their experience and their hopes. Posted on social media with a corresponding blog post on the website. More detailed than the Meet the Guest campaign, and required deeper research.

items.title: Meet the Guest Campaign
items.description: This series introduced Shelter City guests to partners and the wider community. The call to action was an invitation to get in touch rather than a link, keeping the focus on growing each guest's network.

items.title: Highlighting the Shelter City Program
items.description: Communication material outside specific campaigns: events, announcements and information about the Shelter City network and programme.

items.title: Poster Campaign
items.description: For the Global Shelter City Partner Meeting I designed and led the printing of material shown during the meeting, including this poster series.
